Spaghetti Bolognese
Prep: 10 minutes mins
Cook: 30 minutes mins
Total: 40 minutes mins
Servings 5
Course: Dinner
Cuisine: Italian, Western
Jump to Recipe
Print
Ingredients
▢ 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil
▢ 2 garlic cloves , minced
▢ 1 onion , finely chopped (brown, yellow or white)
▢ 1 lb / 500g beef mince (ground beef) OR half pork, half beef (Note 1)
▢ 1/2 cup (125 ml) dry red wine (sub water or beef broth/stock)
▢ 2 beef bouillon cubes , crumbled OR granulated beef bouillon (Note 2)
▢ 800g / 28 oz can crushed tomato (or tomato passata)
▢ 2 tbsp tomato paste
▢ 2 tsp white sugar , if needed (Note 3)
▢ 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
▢ 2 dried bay leaves
▢ 2 sprigs fresh thyme (or 1/2 tsp dried thyme or oregano)
▢ 3/4 tsp cooking salt (kosher salt)
▢ 1/2 tsp black pepper
To Serve
▢ 400 g / 13 oz spaghetti , dried
▢ Parmesan cheese and finely chopped parsley (optional)
Instructions
Sauté – Heat oil in a large pot or…
Cook beef – Turn heat up to high and…
Reduce wine – Add red wine. Bring to simmer…
Simmer – Add the remaining ingredients. Stir, bring to…
Slow simmer option: really takes this to another…
Taste and add more salt it desired. Serve…
Bring a large pot of salted water to…
Scoop out a mug of pasta cooking water and…
Add pasta into the bolognese sauce with about…
Divide between bowls. Garnish with parmesan and parsley…
